purpose: Define a practical full-usage operating mode for SEIS so Design, Developer, DevOps, Coding, LLM, Software Engineering, and AI workstreams can use helpful agents, MCPs, plugins, and installed AI tools deliberately without losing repository truth, provider identity, or public-safe boundaries.
truthBoundary: Full usage means using every useful installed or approved helper in the right role, including repo-owned MCP resources and bounded MCP tools when their risk class allows it. It does not mean blind activation, credential reads, secret capture, silent provider fallback, external MCP writes, deployment, SSH, billing actions, or treating invisible model output as evidence.

repositoryScope.role: primary governance, AI routing, Hermes protocol, and cross-repo operating-mode source of truth
sovereign creative intelligence atelier with its own tool/model orchestration, connector permission matrix, agent swarm, and oracle truth ledger
cloud/SSH center worktree with existing active changes that must not be overwritten
adjacent repo/worktree inventory for read-only discovery before any selected repo edit
repositoryScope.requiredPreflight: identify the exact .git root before editing

fiveYearExecutionModel.remoteSyncPolicy: push verified feature-branch commits after dry-run and explicit approval; never push directly to protected main without authorization
fiveYearExecutionModel.completionRule: A domain is not complete until its source artifact, checker, docs index entry, validation evidence, security note, and next handoff are present.

helperRoles.safeUse: repository edits, validation, terminal checks, integration, and final synthesis
public-safe, tiny review prompts through the verified Computer Use type_text then Send path
Eleni-Neferi tool/model orchestration, connector permission review, agent swarm planning, and oracle truth-ledger checks
Cursor, Kimi, LM Studio, Ollama, or similar helper only after installed/verified status is known

fallbackRules: Provider and model identity must be visible when a helper is used.
If a model or provider is Rate Limited or Error, block that route for the decision and move visibly to the next eligible route.
Never pretend a fallback provider is the original provider.
Local-only or private-work mode must not fall back to cloud.
Deterministic validators outrank uncaptured model output.

providerConnectionPolicy.meaning: The owner reports that providers have been connected, so they may be considered candidates for future route verification.

blockedWithoutExplicitOwnerApproval: browser automation on authenticated private pages

forbiddenActionsWithoutExplicitOwnerAppr: GitHub push or merge without dry-run and explicit approval
completionDefinition: Every selected repo starts with a status/preflight read.
Exactly one repo is selected for writes at a time.
Codex remains the only writer unless a future explicit handoff exists.
Helpers are used as reviewers or bounded agents with visible identity.
MCP usage follows the full-usage MCP binding and permission risk matrix.
Owner-reported provider connection is recorded separately from verified provider readiness.
Fallback behavior is visible and recorded.
No model output is used as evidence unless captured and recorded.
Relevant repo-local validators pass or are honestly marked unavailable.
nextSafeActions: Use this operating mode before cross-repo AI/helper work.
Select one repo and one work item before invoking helpers.
Mirror compatible public-safe guidance into Eleni-Neferi only when that repo is explicitly selected for editing.
Keep SEIS-ssh active diffs untouched unless that worktree becomes the selected target.
